sources.title: Chatterbox: Open Source Text-to-Speech | Resemble AI
sources.snippet: Chatterbox is Resemble AI's free, open-source TTS model, MIT-licensed with emotion control, real-time generation, and zero-shot voice cloning from 5 seconds of audio.

sources.title: Chatterbox TTS - Free Advanced Open-Source Text-to-Speech
sources.snippet: Chatterbox TTS represents a groundbreaking advancement in AI-driven text-to-speech technology, offering unmatched voice quality and emotional expressiveness. Our platform leverages Resemble AI's open-source Chatterbox TTS model to convert text into natural, lifelike speech across various applications.
